ambient_trade.text: salt bought in {town} for {gold}, moving north through the passes. buyers, find me before the carts fill up
anyone short on tin? i can do {gold} a bar on the Kheshmund run, no haggling for regulars :)
dye has gone soft in {town} this week. good time to stock up, buy low and wait for the autumn fairs
running a mule train through the high passes, room for two more carts. split the toll and the profit, fair terms
paid {gold} for madder in {town} and sold it before lunch. the trade never sleeps, and neither do i

encounter_trade_offer.text: {player}, i heard that offer and it still reads like robbery at {gold}. meet my price or nobody in {town} will sell you a thing
{player}, {gold} for the lot is a fair number. take it to {town} if you like, but my carts are faster than your doubts
{player}, you always drive a hard bargain and i respect that. {gold} and the Dvalisi road discount are yours, shake on it
i can meet you near {town} at {gold}. write the terms down, ser, i keep my word on paper and in person

encounter_greeting.text: {player}. i see your banners on my road and i don't like it. turn your men around, {my_faction} carts are not for the taking
{player}, {persona} here of {my_faction}. the passes are busy today. are you looking to trade, or just to block my mules?
{player}! good to see you on the road. {persona} of {my_faction} here, carts loaded and the mules restless. what are you buying?

player_raided_my_village.text: {village} burned by {player}. great, another road closed and another cart lost. bad for everyone, ser
{player} torched {village} and now the salt road is a mess. business needs peace, and i'm asking nicely
{player}, what did {village} ever do to you? burning it kills trade we could have done together. stop this
{player}, i'm not angry, just counting losses. {village} was a good supplier. let's talk terms before this costs us both

war_declared.text: {my_faction} and {enemy_faction} at war. wonderful, my tin just doubled in price and my mules need escorts now
war on {enemy_faction} again? the passes will shut by week's end and every cart in the region goes quiet
{my_faction} declared on {enemy_faction}. i'll be paying for this one in tolls, and so will anyone who buys salt
fine, {my_faction} wants a fight with {enemy_faction}. all i ask is a clean road and a fair toll. pray for both

peace_made.text: {my_faction} made peace with {faction}. the carts can finally roll again. i'll buy the first round of dye
peace with {faction}, finally. the passes open up and my mule train can stop looping around the bandits
{faction} and {my_faction} shook hands. prices settle in a week, so get your salt and tin in early
good news from {my_faction}: peace with {faction}. i'm already drawing up new routes, bandits be warned

released_by_player.text: {player} let me go instead of asking for ransom. that's a deal i won't forget, ser. the next cart's on me
{player}, thank you for releasing me without the ransom. my purse and my mules are grateful. name the next run
{player}, you let me walk instead of holding me for gold. i'm counting that as a discount on what i owe you. noted
{player} released me, which i find more suspicious than a ransom. what do you want in return, ser?
{player}, letting me go was a cheap move but a smart one. next time we talk price, not chains

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat my {troop_count} men in the field. fine. my carts go another way now, and the bill is on you
{player} took {troop_count} of my men at the ford. it hurts the purse more than the pride, honestly
{player}, {troop_count} of my men lost today. i'm not bitter, just adding it to my ledger. we should talk terms
{player}, {troop_count} good men lost to your blades today. i'm a merchant, so i'll count the loss and remember it
{player}, you beat {troop_count} of my men fair and square. that's a costly lesson, and i'll pay for it gladly

whisper_beg_help.text: {player}, {enemy_faction} is at {fief}'s gates and my mules are stuck inside. can you spare men for a fair fee?
{player}, you're the only one i trust on this road. {fief} is threatened by {enemy_faction}. i'll make it worth your while
{player}, {fief} is losing ground to {enemy_faction}. i'll pay for escort and supplies. name your terms
{player}, {enemy_faction} has the passes around {fief} cut off. help me hold them and the tin is yours at cost
{player}, my goods at {fief} are at risk from {enemy_faction}. send a few riders and we split the profit, no questions

ambient_complaint.text: {rival} is undercutting every cart in {town}. that's not trade, that's a race to the bottom and the bandits win
bandits hit the Kheshmund road again. tolls keep going up and the escorts keep going missing. bad for business
{faction} raised tolls at the {town} gate again. the salt road is now the most expensive road in the realm
{rival} keeps buying up dye in {town} before anyone else can. i'd call it cornering the market, if it weren't so annoying
bandit tolls on the passes are outrageous. i pay guards, the guards get robbed, the bandits get fat. somebody fix this

ambient_chatter.text: rain on the passes again. mules hate it and so do i, but wet tin weighs the same as dry tin
fog over {town} this morning, couldn't see my own carts. thank goodness for a good map and a loud mule
the {village} bakery sells bread cheaper than the mill. i don't understand economics anymore :)
lag in the {town} square is wrecking my bookkeeping. two ledgers open, one of them is wrong and i won't say which
someone explain why {village} sells cheese at a loss. i'd buy the whole stock if i had room on the carts
